abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Sanitized PDBs have no retained headers or HETATM ligands, so targets were identified by ATOM-derived sequence search and public PDB coordinate matching. target1 is human Mcl-1 and exactly matches RCSB 4ZBF chain J over 151 CA atoms. target2 is human TYK2 JH2/pseudokinase; closest public coordinate context is RCSB 4WOV chain B with 256 aligned CA, 100% sequence identity, 0.472 A fit RMSD. target3 is human GPR119, not peptide GIPR; it exactly matches RCSB 7XZ5 chain R over 292 CA atoms and is close to APD668-bound 7XZ6 chain R at 0.574 A fit RMSD.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: No raw PDB contents were logged. Key pocket contacts from public co-crystals: Mcl-1 4ZBF/4M7 places a carboxylate near Arg263 and hydrophobic aryl/propyl groups against Leu267, Met250, Phe270, Met231, Leu235, Val253 and Ile294; TYK2 4WOV/3SM uses hinge/pseudokinase contacts around Val690, Leu595, Glu688, Gln597, Tyr689, Arg738 and Leu741; GPR119 7XZ5 LPC and 7XZ6 APD668 share a transmembrane pocket around Glu261, Arg262, Ser156, Phe157/158/174, Trp265/238, Leu169, Val85/93 and Ala89/90. Public context URLs: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/4ZBF https://www.rcsb.org/structure/4WOV https://www.rcsb.org/structure/7XZ5 https://www.rcsb.org/structure/7XZ6

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Public co-crystal ligand families were selected from RCSB/sequence-matched entries: Mcl-1 4M7/4M6/19G/19H carboxylic-acid BH3 groove inhibitors; TYK2 JH2 3SM/BMS-066, 2TT and IK1 pseudokinase ligands; GPR119 APD668/I7J, MBX-2982/8VP, GSK-1292263/A1D8Y, firuglipel/A1D8M and LPC/LSC. NVIDIA DiffDock availability was checked and configured, but final ranking was kept local and reproducible with RDKit, OpenBabel and Vina.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Local tier-1 descriptor/route screen: all drug-like candidates passed except GPR119 LPC/LSC had rotors_gt_10. Co-crystal-pocket Vina used transformed public ligand centers: Mcl-1 4ZBF:4M7 center fit RMSD 0.0 A, TYK2 4WOV:3SM center fit RMSD 0.472 A, GPR119 7XZ6:I7J center fit RMSD 0.574 A. Best pocket affinities by target were Mcl-1 4M7 -11.41 kcal/mol vs 4M6 -11.27 and 19G/19H about -9.4; TYK2 3SM -8.807 vs IK1 -8.126 and 2TT -8.094; GPR119 A1D8Y -12.68, A1D8M -12.39, 8VP -11.53, I7J -10.59. LPC/LSC timed out at 120 s and was rejected for flexibility/prep risk.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Selected one independently researched, target-specific molecule per target. target1 uses the 4M7-family Mcl-1 ligand from the exact 4ZBF receptor context because it preserved the Arg263 carboxylate anchor and had the best local pocket Vina score. target2 uses 3SM/BMS-066 because it is the ligand in the closest 4WOV TYK2 JH2 context and outranked the simpler 2TT/IK1 alternatives in the allosteric pocket. target3 uses GSK-1292263/A1D8Y because it retained the GPR119 agonist pharmacophore while ranking best in the transformed 7XZ6 drug pocket on the exact 7XZ5 receptor frame.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Failure modes considered: Mcl-1 acid ligands can lose score if the carboxylate is not placed near Arg263 or if hydrophobic aryl groups miss the BH3 groove; TYK2 ATP-site-like or too-polar fragments underfill the JH2 allosteric site; GPR119 lipid-like LPC overfits the endogenous state and is high-rotor/evaluator-risk. Rejected branches: Mcl-1 19G/19H lower pocket Vina; TYK2 2TT/IK1 lower pocket Vina despite simpler descriptors; GPR119 LPC/LSC rotors_gt_10 and Vina timeout; APD668/MBX/firuglipel were plausible but scored below A1D8Y in the local GPR119 pocket.
